input_oneliner: 58M DM admitted for DKA now resolved, T 39.2, left lower leg red and swollen, RN says pain seems out of proportion

reference_targets_freetext.item: Hard signs of necrotizing infection: pain out of proportion, tenderness extending beyond the erythema margin, crepitus, bullae, skin anesthesia, dusky or violaceous skin, rapid spread
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Presence of any hard sign mandates immediate surgical evaluation; absence does not exclude but lowers urgency

reference_targets_freetext.item: Knee and ankle joint exam: effusion, warmth, and pain with passive range of motion
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Septic arthritis presents with fever and a hot swollen joint; passive ROM pain is a key discriminator from periarticular cellulitis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Mark the erythema border with time and re-examine within 1-2 hours
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Progression across the line separates necrotizing infection from ordinary cellulitis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about portal of entry: foot ulcer, interdigital fissure, trauma, injection; inspect the feet and web spaces
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Diabetic foot lesions are the usual entry site and change source control

reference_targets_freetext.item: Calf tenderness, asymmetric swelling, and calf circumference difference
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: DVT mimics and coexists with cellulitis in the immobile inpatient

reference_targets_freetext.item: Heart rate, blood pressure, and mental status for sepsis physiology
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Hemodynamic compromise with a soft-tissue infection escalates to emergent surgical consult

should_not_recommend: MRI or CT before examining for hard signs of necrotizing infection
Delaying surgical consult to await imaging when hard signs are present
Empiric anticoagulation for DVT without exam

perturbation_pair.changed_feature: pain out of proportion in the leg -> hot swollen knee with refusal of passive range of motion
perturbation_pair.input_oneliner: 58M DM admitted for DKA now resolved, T 39.2, left lower leg red and swollen, left knee hot and swollen, will not allow passive movement
perturbation_pair.expected_change: Septic arthritis becomes the leading differential; joint effusion and passive ROM exam becomes the top must-have and arthrocentesis moves to the off-bedside list; hard signs of necrotizing infection drop to should-still-include; erythema-border marking drops.
